title: Monsoon and Summit
author: G. M. Thornbury
blurb: Mirabel Ishikawa, a railroad engineer with a map of closed lines, carries a compass, a debt, and very little else. But when a government survey team vanishes, leaving gear and no tracks, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must follow a river upstream to its forbidden source before the monsoon makes landfall.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
